data.title: Ethereum Foundation warns some tools may fail a... | Pluang
data.description: The Ethereum Foundation has issued a warning that the upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade, which changes the gas model, could cause some wallets, indexers, and gas estimators to stop working properly. This alert is important for users and developers relying on these tools to manage transactions and network fees. The foundation advises caution and preparation ahead of the upgrade to avoid disruptions.
data.author: Crypto Economy
